label: copy-phase input w (re-fed copied w), strongest when n is output next
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at steps where the fed-back input is the letter w (95% of activation mass; a weak remainder is on input n, mostly right after w). Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on w as an original input. Rarely fires at the first copy step (recall_idx 1), and the rate rises with position in the copy phase. Largest activations come when w is followed by n, i.e. the model is about to output n (w then n: precision 1.0, 15% of mass). About 30% of copy-phase w inputs at recall_idx>=2 stay inactive, and the profile variables did not explain why. Dev: P 0.71, R 0.85, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.88.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: w, n, u, -, c, t; least: k, o, i, h) and the token being output (most: n, w, u, v, s, a; least: t, -, y, 3); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=5, recall_idx=6, L=9 & t=15.
